text: A name for how many worlds fit in a link: Chrome takes 2,097,152 characters of URL (2 × 1024 × 1024), so after 'https://vovazakharov.com/island#' up to 10^2,097,120 numbers (~870 KB written out). The 'chromeplex'. Funny, if debatable. Its proper name: one hundred sesexagintasescentilliquinsexagintasescentillion (that one is 10^2,000,000).
